_om: Scenen bak hovedseksjonen på /sjekk. Siden gjør én ting: den henter forsiden din og viser hva som ligger inne i den. Motivet er derfor bokstavelig, ikke en metafor – en blank, umerket plate som en tynn lyslinje sveiper over, og der linjen har passert står platen åpen og det konstruerte indre er synlig. Platen selv forblir anonym hele veien, akkurat som en nettside som ser helt vanlig ut utenfra. Brandboken ble strammet inn 6. oktober 2026: hvert bilde må bestå prøven «dekk til teksten – skjønner en rørlegger hva det handler om?». 14 av 16 genererte motiver strøk på den. Dette skal bestå, fordi sveip-og-avdekk er nøyaktig operasjonen verktøyet utfører.
_bevar: Keep exactly identical: camera position, perspective, framing, lighting direction and intensity, rim light, the near-black #0b0d10 background, and the size, proportions, position, thickness, material and surface finish of the main panel. The panel never moves, rotates, tilts, scales or changes shape. Its outer face stays plain, blank and unmarked - no text, letters, numbers, logos, icons or watermarks anywhere. The number of internal layers is the same in every frame.
_bevegelse: Locked-off static camera; the camera does not move, zoom, pan, tilt or reframe. Silent product shot, constant exposure. Start exactly on the first frame and end exactly on the last frame. The panel is rigid: it keeps its exact outline, size, thickness, position and material in every single frame, and never bends, melts, morphs, warps or rotates. The same number of internal layers is visible wherever the panel is open. Lighting, reflections and the near-black background stay constant. Avoid: camera movement, camera shake, zoom, pan, cut, scene change, lens switch, morphing, melting, warping, extra objects, missing objects, text, letters, logos, watermark, flicker, particles, lens flare, motion blur, depth-of-field change.

scener._hvorfor: Bokstavelig for siden: en flate som ser helt vanlig ut blir skannet, og det som ligger inne i den kommer til syne. Platen er anonym – det er poenget, for sjekken kjører mot hvilken som helst nettside og vi navngir aldri de som kommer dårlig ut. Lyslinjen er den ene aksenten brandboken tillater. Geometrien står bom stille hele veien: bare linjen flytter seg og avdekkingen vokser bak den, så Kling har ingenting å morfe.
scener.basisPrompt: A single flat rectangular panel of matte bead-blasted anodised aluminium, standing upright and seen almost straight on, rotated only about 8 degrees so the right side recedes very slightly. The panel is wider than it is tall. It fills the RIGHT 60 percent of the frame; the left 40 percent is calm empty near-black studio void for typography. The panel's front face is one single continuous plain surface: smooth, blank, matte and completely featureless, edge to edge. The panel is closed and solid, with no openings, seams, cut-outs, insets, recesses, screens or inner panels. IMPORTANT: this image contains NO green and NO colour of any kind - it is entirely neutral greyscale aluminium on near-black. There is no border, no frame, no bezel, no outline, no rim, no edge lighting and no glowing line anywhere. Cool neutral 5600K light rakes from the upper left; deep controlled shadow behind the panel.
scener.bevar: Keep exactly identical: camera position, perspective, framing, lighting direction and intensity, the near-black #0b0d10 background, and the outline, size, proportions, position, thickness, material and surface finish of the flat panel. The panel never moves, rotates, tilts, scales or changes shape, and its four outer edges stay in exactly the same place. The panel's edges never glow and never carry a coloured border, frame, bezel or outline. No text, letters, numbers, logos, icons or watermarks anywhere.
scener.start: Change only the markings ON the panel's flat front face. Draw ONE single straight horizontal lime green #c8f24a hairline that CROSSES the middle of the face from its left side to its right side, positioned high up at about 15 percent of the panel's height from the top. This line is a scanning beam lying flat on the surface: it is one isolated straight segment, it does not touch, follow, trace or join any of the panel's four outer edges, and it has clear plain aluminium on all sides of it. It is NOT a border, frame, bezel or outline. The rest of the face, both above and below the line, is plain featureless aluminium exactly as before. No other green anywhere in the image.
scener.slutt: Change only the markings ON the panel's flat front face. The SAME single straight horizontal lime green #c8f24a hairline has moved down and now crosses the face low down, at about 85 percent of the panel's height from the top. It is still one isolated straight segment that does not touch, follow or trace the panel's outer edges, and it is still not a border or frame. ABOVE that line the aluminium face now carries a fine, precise, regular rectangular grid of very shallow machined channels, engraved flush into the surface, neutral grey with no colour, like technical structure revealed under the skin. BELOW the line the face is still plain featureless aluminium. The panel's outline, size, position, thickness and lighting are unchanged.
scener.bevegelse: One single continuous movement at constant speed from the first frame to the last: the straight lime green hairline travels steadily and smoothly straight down the flat front face of the panel, staying perfectly horizontal and the same length the whole way, from high near the top to low near the bottom. As the line passes over the surface, the plain aluminium it leaves behind above it gradually takes on a fine regular rectangular grid of shallow machined channels, which then stays completely fixed and never shifts, slides or changes. The panel itself stays absolutely still: identical outline, size, position, thickness, material and lighting in every frame. The line never touches or follows the panel's outer edges and never becomes a border or frame. Nothing is added to or removed from the frame.
scener._komposisjon: Panelet dekker 37-89 % av bredden i masteren, maalt med .skudd/sjekk-geo.mjs. Masken skjuler venstre side, saa motivet skyves 8 % til hoeyre. Det trengs ikke mer: motivet er ROMLIG JEVNT - en gjentakende rutestruktur og en linje som spenner hele panelet - saa en maskert venstrekant tar ikke bort noe man maa se. Det er forskjellen fra /apper-og-ai, der motivet var ETT objekt i venstre tredel og masken skar bort 80 % av det.
